name: mcp-tooling
description: Parent hub for six MCP tool bridges: three workflow modes (mcp-click-up for ClickUp task management, mcp-obsidian for Obsidian vault and markdown-note management, and mcp-notion for Notion workspace operations) plus three read-only design transports (mcp-figma bridging to Figma Desktop, mcp-refero searching real-app UI references, and mcp-mobbin researching mobile-app patterns). The advisor sees one hub identity and workflowMode selects the packet. mcp-code-mode is shared infrastructure, not a hub member.
